fixtureBoundary: RunContext, owned sender and PTY identity are I preconditions; no real OS PTY/model.
Fixture snapshot is type-cast to scripted-test because public Runner/profile/B-package schema is not generalized; only trusted NativeEvidenceAdapterRegistry is extended.
L2/L3 callback explicitly fixture-enables parsers for contract testing; this is not a released version/authorization-level promotion.
Actual production NativeUserInputs creates receipt; no fabricated receipt, IO mock, verify mock or claim implementation.
Scripted adapter only implements deterministic log-format parsing and lookup; generic budget ownership deliberately left with host, as documented by new adapter interface.

criteria.criterion: 实际Codex格式与注册测试格式运行同一合同，正例产对应证据
criteria.actual: The same describe.each contract runs actual builtin Codex NativeEvidenceAdapter and one scripted-test registry entry through unchanged NativeUserMessages. Both produce exactly one matched user proof, one Skill read and one discovery. Before real NativeUserInputs.observe creates a committed receipt, identical user record is no-match; verify rejects copied proof and claim rejects reuse for another intent.

criteria.criterion: 畸形、tool输出伪用户与跨格式拒绝
criteria.actual: Both adapters reject malformed/null/partial JSON, wrong role/tool-as-user, assistant/tool catalog spoofing, other format under valid header and other format header. Unknown Agent returns unsupported rather than Codex fallback; adapter lacking optional L3 returns unsupported.

criteria.criterion: 替换/链接/截断和身份重核
criteria.actual: Both adapters use real filesystem locate/open/header/stat and host verify. File/ancestor symlinks produce zero evidence. Inode replacement invalidates branded proof, truncated user record produces no proof/evidence, wrong session header rejects every channel. Incomplete final newline remains uncertified until exact final newline arrives.

criteria.criterion: 超字节尾窗和时间窗口不得误认证
criteria.actual: Positive records followed by >4MiB padding fall outside the real bounded read tail; stale records are rejected. Host preserves current bounded-tail semantics for long histories, rather than treating any total file over4MiB as invalid.

criteria.criterion: 超records与超单行预算不得误发现/读取
criteria.actual: Codex rejects both scenarios (own parser includes budgets). Scripted format receives 8193 extra records or >1MiB whitespace-prefixed valid Skill records from host and returns one read + one discovery in each case; host accepts them. User-message read correctly rejects records as TOO_LARGE or skips long lines, so defect is specific to shared Skill path.

defect.cause: Host caps tail bytes but passes unrestricted record count and oversized lines to new format parser; only builtin Codex parser happened to enforce them.
defect.expected: Generic host Skill reader enforces <=8192 parsed records and ignores records over1MiB before format parser invocation.

rawEvidence.nativeSourceLogs: All inputs <16KiB archived byte-for-byte as evidence-log-*.jsonl. Oversized/over-record/tail fixtures recorded by exact input SHA256, byte/line counts, private generation source and raw result objects; no full large source dump.
rawEvidence.sourceTypingOnlyChange: After contract runner, annotated three format selector arguments as string for TypeScript; no executable logic/assertion changed. Final node typecheck passed.
